## File: algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/examples/alphaevolve_math_problems/hexagon_packing/11/evaluator.py

Prompts

```
['run the evaluator on a hexagon packing program and return its combined score and eval time', 'verify a hexagon packing construction by checking disjointness and containment of all inner hexagons', 'check if two hexagons are disjoint given their center, side length, and rotation parameters', 'check if a given point lies inside a hexagon defined by its center, side length, and angle', 'generate the six vertex coordinates of a regular hexagon given its center, side length, and rotation', 'run hexagon_packing_11 to get coordinates of 11 unit hexagons packed inside a larger hexagon', 'review hexagon_packing_11 to analyze the grid arrangement of 11 inner hexagons', 'refactor hexagon_packing_11 to optimize the outer hexagon side length for tighter packing', 'test hexagon_packing_11 to verify all 11 inner hexagons are disjoint and fit inside the outer hexagon', 'summarize hexagon_packing_11 to understand the returned numpy arrays for inner and outer hexagon data']
```

Usage

```
{'evaluate_hexagon_packing_program': 'run the evaluator on a hexagon packing program and return its combined score and eval time', 'verify_hexagon_construction': 'verify a hexagon packing construction by checking disjointness and containment of all inner hexagons', 'check_hexagons_disjoint': 'check if two hexagons are disjoint given their center, side length, and rotation parameters', 'check_point_inside_hexagon': 'check if a given point lies inside a hexagon defined by its center, side length, and angle', 'generate_hexagon_vertices': 'generate the six vertex coordinates of a regular hexagon given its center, side length, and rotation'}
```
